sgp_meta.note: 1 game(s) on this card carry a rated leg and 3 carry a shoppable line row. ⛔ No combined chance is published for a same-game slip and no EV is either — the legs are correlated, so the product of their records would be a percentage asserting something false. The payout shown is the straight product of the prices, which is the MOST a book will pay for a correlated slip. ⚠️ Sam's 1.8x floor is applied to that upper bound, which is sound in one direction only: a slip whose upper bound misses the floor can never reach it. The ceiling is deliberately NOT applied, because an upper bound above it may be inside it once the book discounts.

sgp_rule: Same-game parlays from this card's own rows, ordered by each slip's WEAKEST leg — that leg's own record at its exact line. ⛔ No combined chance is shown and no EV is: the legs are in one game, so multiplying their records would assert they are independent when they are not. The payout is the straight product of the prices, which is the MOST a book pays for a correlated slip.
parlay_rule: Legs are in DIFFERENT GAMES and at the SAME BOOK. ⛔ Every number is the player's own record — nothing here is a model output, and the combined figure is those records multiplied, which assumes the games are unrelated.

single_day_rule: This board is 2026-09-18 only. Priced rows for another day are not shown here and neither are parlays that would cross days — a card dated one day and half-filled with the next is two facts under one label. Minimum 5, maximum 25; a day with no games is an empty board, and that is correct.
coverage: 44 priced football rows for 2026-09-18 across 1 board games; 25 shown.
calibration_warning: under-60 hit 52.9% against a claimed 41.2% (+11.8 pts, n=51); 80-plus hit 72.4% against a claimed 87% (-14.6 pts, n=29). The under-60 band is currently the closest to its own claim. 60-70 and 70-80 have too few graded plays to read. 80 graded College Football plays behind these figures, under the 100 this project needs before it will call a percentage a rate — so read them as history rather than a measured rate, and every one of them will move.
board_rule: Sorted by the player's own record at that exact line, highest first — the same order the MLB board uses. Rows with no record sit below every row that has one.
no_model_note: 🔴 No row on this board carries a Gizmo's confidence rating and none ever will on today's evidence. Four pre-registered football models were tested and every one lost to a player's own season average. What is shown is his OWN RECORD and the market's price — both labelled.
college_note: College records are counted over the games a player appears in. College box scores list him only when he did something, so a game he played quietly can be missing — which nudges an over slightly high. That gap was measured against the NFL, where the true figure is known: a median of 0.2 percentage points and 3.8 at the 90th percentile. Short reception lines, where the gap is biggest, carry no record at all.
